conditions.after: 300 K; p-type (Bi,Sb)2Te3 with a trace amount of CuGaTe2 in solid solution

after: The solid solution of a trace amount of CuGaTe2 could change the chemical bonds in (Bi,Sb)(2)Te-3 from unitary valent bonds to mixed (ionic and valent) bonds.
The bond diversification then results in a significant reduction of the lattice thermal conductivity from 0.76 to 0.58 W m(-1) K-1 at 300 K.
